title: Inspect automatic silence in review history
steps: Inspect the loaded pending flagged post and author icon, scrolling slightly to frame Timeline & notes.
Open the flagged author's user card to inspect the current silence and reason.
Dismiss the user card and open the Yes action dropdown.
Choose Delete post and inspect the updated review status and timeline.

video_guide.summary: Inspect the existing automatic silence on the author card, then compare it with the review timeline after Delete post.

chapters.note: The pending spam review’s Timeline & notes lists post creation and spam flagging, followed by the notes field; no silence event is shown.

chapters.label: Open the flagged author’s user card

chapters.note: The casey_review card says This user is silenced and Reason: Silenced automatically.

chapters.label: Dismiss the user card and open the Yes menu

chapters.note: The Yes menu includes Delete post.
The review is marked Flag approved; Timeline & notes includes Post deleted by morgan_review and Approved by morgan_review.
The timeline shows creation, flagging, deletion and approval, with no automatic-silence entry.
